behaviors.name: Stalk
behaviors.intent: Circle the ruins slowly, as if it has all the time in the world.
behaviors.source:
behavior Stalk
  var home = (0, 0, 0)
  on start
    home = self.position
  end
  on tick
    let a = time * 0.16
    self.position = home + (cos(a) * 6.5, sin(time * 0.7) * 0.6, sin(a) * 4.5)
    self.rotation = (sin(time * 0.9) * 4, 0 - a * 57.3 + 180, sin(time * 0.7) * 5)
  end
end

behaviors.name: Dangle
behaviors.intent: The lure pulses like a heartbeat.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let p = max(0, sin(time * 2.4))
  self.scale = (0.2 + p * 0.06, 0.2 + p * 0.06, 0.2 + p * 0.06)
end

behaviors.name: Drift
behaviors.intent: Rise in soft pulses, then sink back down; wrap around.
behaviors.source:
behavior Drift
  var phase = 0
  on start
    phase = self.id * 0.7
  end
  on tick
    let p = max(0, sin(time * 1.6 + phase))
    move self by (sin(time * 0.3 + phase) * 0.15 * dt, (p * 0.9 - 0.18) * dt, 0)
    self.scale = (1 - p * 0.12, 1 + p * 0.18, 1 - p * 0.12)
    if self.position.y > 14 then
      self.position.y = 1.5
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Cruise
behaviors.intent: Cruise slowly across the trench, rocking a little, sweeping its spotlight.
behaviors.source:
behavior Cruise
  on tick
    move self by (0.75 * dt, sin(time * 0.8) * 0.12 * dt, 0)
    self.rotation = (sin(time * 0.5) * 6, sin(time * 0.35) * 12, sin(time * 0.9) * 2)
    if self.position.x > 22 then
      self.position.x = -22
    end
  end
end

behaviors.name: Spin
behaviors.intent: Spin.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  rotate self by (420 * dt, 0, 0)
end

behaviors.name: School
behaviors.intent: Swim with the school in a tight loop around the columns.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let a = time * self.speed + self.phase
  self.position = (-4 + cos(a) * self.r, self.h + sin(a * 2) * 0.3, -9 + sin(a) * self.r * 0.7)
  self.rotation = (0, 0 - a * 57.3, 90)
end

behaviors.name: Pulse
behaviors.intent: Pulse with the lure.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.light.intensity = 2.6 + max(0, sin(time * 2.4)) * 2.2
end

behaviors.name: Follow
behaviors.intent: Trail the submarine from behind and a little above.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let s = find("Submarine")
  if exists(s) then
    self.position = lerp(self.position, s.position + (-5.5, 2.2, 7.5), 0.05)
    look self at s.position + (5, -0.6, -3)
  end
end
